items.headline: Manchester United beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties after 1-1 draw at Croke Park
items.summary: Man United drew 1-1 with Leeds United in a pre-season friendly at Croke Park, Dublin, winning 5-4 on penalties. Joshua Zirkzee scored; Marcus Rashford was absent.

items.headline: Michael Carrick hopes trio will be available for Milan
items.summary: Carrick indicated three players may be unavailable for the upcoming friendly against Milan, with hopes they could return.
